fields.description: Direct: a Payment Entry is created and submitted with the Share Transaction. Clearing: the amount stays in the Clearing Account until Accounts creates the Payment Entry.
fields.label: Accounting Mode

fields.description: Share Transactions post to this account first. The Payment Entry moves the money between this account and the bank.
fields.label: Clearing Account

fields.description: Pre-fills the Bank or Cash Account on Share Transactions. It can be changed on each transaction.
fields.label: Default Bank or Cash Account

fields.description: Credited at face value on Issue. Debited at face value on Retirement.
fields.label: Share Capital Account

fields.description: Credited with the amount received above face value on Issue.
fields.label: Securities Premium Account

fields.description: Debited with the buyback cost. Credited when treasury shares are reissued or retired.
fields.label: Treasury Shares Account

fields.description: Receives the difference between treasury cost and the reissue price, or between treasury cost and face value on Retirement. It never affects Profit and Loss.
fields.label: Treasury Gain / Loss Account
